sayWindow: MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Molt. It resonates with: something unnamed.
(−100 kcal — food becomes molt.)
🪨 Catalina pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (8 stone now.)
🍲 George cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
🍂 Jude gathers deadfall — 2 sticks + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (6 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — George telling Jovan about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Catalina telling Brayden about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
💧 George returns with water: +2 clean.
🗣️ Nathan to Catalina, by the fire: "42 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
🌟 THE SKY SPLITS OPEN.
Not with light. With... interface. Windows scrolling across the clouds, too fast to read.
A voice behind your eyes — bright, delighted, utterly wrong. (The System has arrived.)
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📖 Your journal shimmers — handwriting dissolving into interface. It talks now. It remembers everything.
🕐 Your hand-drawn time-circle glitches — and something colder, more precise, takes its place. (We kept the smudges. They're charming.)
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 The village gathers. Everyone's journal is changing. Everyone hears the voice. Jude grabs your arm. "Tell me you hear that too."
🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
"Choose wisely! Or don't! Betrayal arcs test VERY well with our demographics!"
A new option appears when you look at people: invite them to your party.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
★ IDENTIFIED: Açaí. Dark berries on a tall thin palm. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
📚 Village knowledge: Jude taught everyone about Açaí. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Strychnine Tree. Poison-nut tree (kuchila). The fruit looks friendly. The seeds are strychnine. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.
📚 Village knowledge: Noah taught everyone about Strychnine Tree. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Cupuaçu. Big brown pod, incredible smell, tangy cream inside. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
📚 Village knowledge: Nathan taught everyone about Cupuaçu. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
★ IDENTIFIED: Chinese Chestnut. Chestnut. Spiny burrs splitting to show brown nuts. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
Jovan was watching. Now they know Chinese Chestnut too.
📚 Village knowledge: Catalina taught everyone about Chinese Chestnut. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1046 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Sigrun is showing Brayden how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
Catalina drew Chinese Chestnut in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

George spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Hickory Nuts — named, and out.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 35. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 3."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Hickory Nuts. Hickory nut. Hard shell, sweet meat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what George was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
Catalina had the day of their life — 2649 kcal. The pantry can't take it all: 1325 kcal goes in, 1324 kcal is eaten at the fire.
Nathan and George lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Nathan looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."

The northwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. Emberhold isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 8 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 2 unknown nuts went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 5 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Açaí — named and noted.
📓 Codex: The System offered an aid quest (learn), day 8.
Jude Jenkins reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
